facts.en: Completed a food-retail operations certificate at Fictional Cloverbank College in 2022.
facts.zh: 2022 年在虚构三叶草岸学院完成食品零售运营证书课程。

facts.en: Paid route support assistant at Fictional Butterfern Dairy from 2023-05 to 2026-08.
facts.zh: 2023-05 至 2026-08 在虚构奶油蕨乳品农场任有薪路线支持助理。

facts.en: Matched packed bottle counts to the morning order sheet before the driver loaded the van.
facts.zh: 在司机装车前，将已装箱瓶数与晨间订单表核对。

facts.en: Separated new deliveries from empty-bottle returns on the route sheet.
facts.zh: 在路线表上将新配送与空瓶回收分开记录。

facts.en: Rode as the driver’s assistant on local rounds, checked delivery labels and collected receipt signatures.
facts.zh: 在本地配送中随车担任司机助理，核对配送标签并收集签收。

facts.en: The driver operated the van; the candidate’s recorded duties did not include driving.
facts.zh: 车辆由司机驾驶；候选人记录中的职责不包括驾驶。

facts.en: Copied logger readings onto dispatch forms and reported readings outside the farm’s supplied limits to the dispatch lead.
facts.zh: 将记录仪读数抄录至发运表，并将超出农场所给限值的读数报告给发运负责人。

facts.en: The dispatch lead decided whether a load could leave; the candidate did not authorize product release.
facts.zh: 发运负责人决定货物能否出发；候选人不授权产品放行。

facts.en: Tested a revised returns column during 5 morning rounds in 2025-06.
facts.zh: 2025-06 在 5 次晨间配送中测试修订后的回收栏。

facts.en: Across those rounds, the shared route sheet recorded 286 full bottles delivered and 241 empty bottles collected.
facts.zh: 这些配送的共同路线表记录送出 286 瓶乳品（满瓶），并收回 241 个空瓶。

facts.en: The full and empty bottles came from different purchase cycles; the figures are not a loss or spoilage count.
facts.zh: 满瓶与空瓶来自不同购买周期；这些数值不是遗失或变质数量。

facts.en: Recorded customer requests for the next delivery and passed quantity changes to the order clerk before the cutoff.
facts.zh: 记录客户下次配送请求，并在截止时间前将数量变更转交订单文员。

facts.en: Uses printed stop lists, handheld barcode scanning and spreadsheet totals.
facts.zh: 使用纸质停靠点清单、手持条码扫描及电子表格汇总。

facts.en: Suggested moving 2 stops earlier after collecting customer time preferences in 2026-02; the route lead approved the revised order.
facts.zh: 2026-02 收集客户时间偏好后建议将 2 个停靠点提前；路线负责人批准修订顺序。

facts.en: Completed an internal load-handling and cleaning induction in 2023-05; the records name no external food-safety qualification.
facts.zh: 2023-05 完成内部货物搬运及清洁入职培训；记录未列出外部食品安全资格。

facts.en: Volunteered at Fictional Cobblepea Market on 3 Saturdays in 2024, setting up stalls and directing visitors to vendors.
facts.zh: 2024 年在 3 个星期六为虚构卵豆集市做志愿者，布置摊位并指引访客前往商户。

facts.en: Planned a personal bicycle picnic route in 2025 using a consumer map application; it did not include commercial deliveries.
facts.zh: 2025 年使用消费级地图应用规划个人骑行野餐路线；不涉及商业配送。

facts.en: Enjoys carving decorative soap shapes at home.
facts.zh: 爱好在家雕刻装饰性肥皂造型。

facts.en: The regular work pattern was morning rounds from Monday through Friday.
facts.zh: 常规工作模式为星期一至星期五的晨间配送。

facts.en: No commercial route-optimization software use is recorded.
facts.zh: 未记录使用商业路线优化软件的经历。
